paper.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

result.summary: 本文提出残差学习框架以缓解深层网络训练困难的问题，将堆叠层改为学习相对于输入的残差函数 [S1.p5]。在 ImageNet 上评估了最深达 152 层的残差网络，其复杂度仍低于 VGG 网络 [abstract]。实验表明残差网络更易优化，并能从显著增加的深度中获得精度提升 [abstract]。该集成模型在 ImageNet 测试集上取得 3.57% 错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：当网络能够开始收敛后，随着深度增加会出现退化问题——准确率饱和并迅速下降，且该退化并非由过拟合引起，增加层数反而导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。作者指出，按构造存在一个解使更深模型不应比其较浅对应模型产生更高训练误差，但实验表明现有求解器无法找到可比或更好的解 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly.
such degradation is not caused by overfitting, and adding more layers to a suitably deep model leads to higher training error
The existence of this constructed solution indicates that a deeper model should produce no higher training error than its shallower counterpart.
But experiments show that our current solvers on hand are unable to find solutions that are comparably good or better than the constructed solution

method.text: 论文提出深度残差学习框架，让堆叠的非线性层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，原始映射被重构为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。该形式通过前馈神经网络中的“捷径连接”实现，捷径连接执行恒等映射，其输出加到堆叠层的输出上，且不增加额外参数或计算复杂度 [S1.p6]。当输入输出维度不同时，可用线性投影 W_s 匹配维度，但实验表明恒等映射足以解决退化问题且更经济 [S3.SS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
The original mapping is recast into $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})+\mathbf{x}$.
The formulation of $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})+\mathbf{x}$ can be realized by feedforward neural networks with “shortcut connections”
Identity shortcut connections add neither extra parameter nor computational complexity.
we will show by experiments that the identity mapping is sufficient for addressing the degradation problem and is economical

experiments.text: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集（1000 类，128 万训练图像，5 万验证图像，10 万测试图像）上评估方法，报告 top-1 和 top-5 错误率 [S4.SS1.p1]。在 CIFAR-10 数据集（5 万训练图像、1 万测试图像、10 类）上进行了更多研究，关注极深网络的行为 [S4.SS2.p1]。此外，在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 上采用 Faster R-CNN 进行目标检测基线实验 [S4.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
The models are trained on the 1.28 million training images, and evaluated on the 50k validation images.
We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
Table 8 and 8 show the object detection baseline results on PASCAL VOC 2007 and 2012 and COCO.
We adopt Faster R-CNN as the detection method.

findings.text: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层普通网络比 18 层普通网络验证误差更高，且整个训练过程中训练误差都更高 [S4.SS1.p3]。残差学习下情况反转：34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 好 2.8%，且 34 层 ResNet 相比其普通对应网络将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。50/101/152 层 ResNet 比 34 层更准确，未观察到退化问题，并从显著增加的深度中获得精度提升 [S4.SS1.p15]。152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证误差为 4.49%，六模型集成在测试集上取得 3.57% top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 克服了优化困难并在深度增加时表现出精度提升，110 层网络达到 6.43% 错误率 [S4.SS2.p5][S4.SS2.p6]。

evidence.quote: the deeper 34-layer plain net has higher validation error than the shallower 18-layer plain net.
the 34-layer plain net has higher training error throughout the whole training procedure
the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%).
the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2)
The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins
We do not observe the degradation problem and thus enjoy significant accuracy gains from considerably increased depth.
Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%.
This leads to 3.57% top-5 error on the test set (Table 5). This entry won the 1st place in ILSVRC 2015.
our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases.
yet is among the state-of-the-art results (6.43%, Table 6).

limitations.text: 作者指出，1202 层网络虽然训练误差与 110 层网络相似，但测试结果更差，作者认为这是因为过拟合，且该网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大 [S4.SS2.p9]。作者表示本文未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。此外，作者提到深层普通网络优化困难的原因有待未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

evidence.quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
We argue that this is because of overfitting.
The 1202-layer network may be unnecessarily large (19.4M) for this small dataset.
In this paper, we use no maxout/dropout and just simply impose regularization via deep and thin architectures by design
But combining with stronger regularization may improve results, which we will study in the future.
The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.
